rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for tuberculosis in everyday speech.

example.english: People used to be very afraid when they heard the word tuberculosis.
example.traditional: 以前啲人一聽到肺癆就好驚。
example.jyutping: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 jat1 teng1 dou3 fai3 lou4 zau6 hou2 geng1

rows.note: A speaker uses this more formal medical term when discussing a diagnosis or medical information.

example.english: The doctor said the test results showed that I had tuberculosis and needed to start taking medicine immediately.
example.traditional: 醫生話檢查結果顯示我有肺結核，要即刻開始食藥。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 waa6 gim2 caa4 git3 gwo2 hin2 si6 ngo5 jau5 fai3 git3 hat6 jiu3 zik1 hak1 hoi1 ci2 sik6 joek6
